faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How much can I save with solar panels?
faq.answer1: Savings vary based on your energy consumption, system size, and location. Our calculator can give you an estimate, and a detailed consultation will provide precise figures.
faq.question2: What is the lifespan of a solar panel system?
faq.answer2: Most solar panel systems are designed to last 25-30 years or more, with minimal maintenance.
faq.question3: Do I need batteries with my solar system?
faq.answer3: Batteries are optional but recommended for energy independence and backup power during outages. We can discuss the best solution for your needs.
